apiIntegration: Fetched fixture OpenAPI -> production OpenApiSpecParser -> reviewed allowlisted HttpApiTools; automatic import timing excludes human onboarding
modelNormalizationPolicy: Production initializer completes blank visible keys before stability digest; existing effective values must remain identical; no source model.conf writes
routingPolicy: Trusted context explicitly sets needsKnowledgeBase=true, needsWebSearch=false, thinkingLevel=off; existing GapAnalyzer Tier0 returns the complete explicit choice without calling the configured JEV provider; native loop uses the same choices; no routing benchmark
comparisonPolicy: Same corpus chunks, embedding, reranker, signed handles, authority checks, business tools and credentials; catalog selection enabled only in wiki_on; native loop shares Cyrene tools/security and raw source retrieval
credentialBoundary: Direct Cyrene invocation mirrors ChatHandler trusted credential injection into HttpApiTool; both runtimes restore the preceding credential scope in finally; credentials never enter tool arguments
contaminationControls: All groups force SOURCE_DOCUMENT; memory-save/update tools denied; long-term injected knowledge budget is zero; each run has a fresh session
executionPolicy: Current AgentOrchestrator/ReAct for wiki groups with fresh CancellationToken; LangChain4j AiServices for native loop; fresh authenticated session and transactional fixture reset per trial; condition order rotates per task/repetition; runtime errors with no recorded model usage stop after writing row/summary, correctness failures continue
baselineLimit: LangChain4j native tool loop with shared Cyrene tools/security; no independent Spring AI Alibaba or AgentScope deployment
modelSamplingPolicy: All groups use current ChatModel with identical configured temperature/max output tokens and provider planningRequestParameters for explicit thinkingLevel=off
setupTokenUsageAvailability: Ingestion API does not expose model token usage; no inferred setup token or monetary cost
evaluatorPolicy: Answer text checks use NFKC, ignore Unicode whitespace, and enforce numeric/ASCII identifier boundaries; raw answers preserved; fixture JSON/state comparisons exact; no model/semantic judge
